answer: A trust spiral gates entry: each new identity must lock a deposit in a time-locked vault and complete a chain of verified micro-tasks attested by independent peers before it can trade. Every additional identity funded from the same source must post a larger deposit and a longer lock, so the cost of N clones grows superlinearly. Honest agents who pass accumulate in a shared oasis of established reputations, where work is cheaper; clones stall outside it, paying rising deposits for identities that never earn trust.
